releaseTitle: ATalk v3.10.1 — Ultra-Premium Glassmorphism & Bento Vault Backup Studio
releaseNotes:
• 01 Ultra-Premium Glassmorphism Architecture: Multi-layer directional specular gradient refractions, bimodal light rims, sub-pixel inner bevels, and chromatic caustic ambient drop shadows.
• 02 Bento-Grid Vault Backup Studio: Complete overhaul of the chat backup UI into tactile Bento cards, eliminating raw numbered form styling.
• 03 Password Lockout Typo Safeguards: Interactive password visibility eye toggles and instant confirmation match verification.
• 04 Real-time Live Archive Estimator: Dynamic live calculation of selected chats, message count, and media footprint.
• 05 Frosted Glass Chat Picker: Full-height glass studio with instant conversation search and contact avatars.
• 06 Frosted Glass Restore Console: Decryption console with password visibility, manifest overview chips, and animated recovery progress.
• 07 Navigation Drawer Refinement: 'Storage & Data' routes directly to dedicated Storage & Cache Management; removed the redundant bottom 'Lock Vault' button.
